name: How long does loose flooring repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does loose flooring repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of loose flooring repair depends on the scope of the project. A small, isolated repair, such as fixing a few squeaky boards, might be completed within a few hours. Larger repairs involving subfloor work, extensive re-installation, or addressing water damage could take one to several days. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring quality. Our team will provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to several days for extensive repairs involving subfloor work or water damage.
